title: 残り火の三番人
concept: 斬撃で得る熱を火術へ変え、敵の予告に合わせて防御や薬を挟む。盾には火術、重い一撃には防御という使い分けに、熱の上限と冷気の損失を重ねる。三戦に体力と薬を持ち越す短い旅。
howToPlay: 敵の次の行動を見て四つのボタンから選びます。斬ると熱+2、火術は熱3を使って6傷。防御は5傷を防ぎます。熱6を超えると火傷します。
libraryDecision: 敵の予告と手札の比較が中心なので、2Dの大きな像とHTMLの数値を使う。3Dの戦場や描画・物理の棚で情報を散らさず、四つの行動の判断を前面に置く。
soundDecision: 音は付けず、敵の予告と前の行動結果を自分のペースで読む静かな戦いにする。効果は文字と状態変化で伝える。

improvements.found: 体力と熱が数字だけで比較しにくい／熱の上限超過と火術の盾無視が画面から分からない／結果が最後の一撃を隠す。
improvements.changed: 体力・熱・敵体力のバーを加え、火傷と盾無視の短い説明を常設。結果を下の余白へ移し、戦闘の状態と最後の結果を残した。
improvements.foundEn: Numbers alone slow health and heat comparisons; burn and shield bypass rules are unclear; results hide the last hit.
improvements.changedEn: Added player health, heat and enemy health bars, a short burn and shield rule, and a bottom result panel retaining the combat state.

improvements.found: 次の一手だけではための後を準備しづらい／斬撃・火術・防御が数値の変化だけで手応えが薄い／倒した敵が次の攻撃を予告し続ける。
improvements.changed: 二手目の短い予告を追加。攻撃時の像の揺れと光、防御・回復時の色を加えた。決着後は敵を暗くし、予告を戦闘終了へ切り替える。
improvements.foundEn: One-action previews limit preparation; cuts, fire and guard feel mostly numerical; defeated foes keep announcing attacks.
improvements.changedEn: Added a compact second-action preview, attack shake and light, guard and healing color feedback, and a dimmed defeated foe with a battle-over message.

candidates.idea: 残り火の三番人。斬撃で熱をため、火術と防御で三連戦を抜ける。3D戦場より、大きな平面像と予告札で行動を比較させる。
candidates.ideaEn: Three Keepers of the Ember: build heat with cuts and use fire and guard through three battles. A flat figure and intention panel clarify choices better than a 3D battlefield.

candidates.idea: 曇りガラスの庭。指で窓を拭くと奥の植物が光を受けて育つ。3Dの奥行きが日陰を発見する役割を持つ、終わりのない観察遊び。
candidates.ideaEn: Fogged Glass Garden: wipe a window to grow plants behind it. 3D depth reveals shaded areas in an endless observation toy.

candidates.idea: ひも先の音符。弦の長さを動かして旋律を作り、小鳥の歌に返す。2Dの弦の波形と指の動きを対応させ、音を核にする。
candidates.ideaEn: Notes on a String: change string lengths to answer a bird's melody. Flat waveforms connect finger movement directly to sound.

en.title: Three Keepers of the Ember
en.concept: Turn heat from cuts into fire, guarding or healing according to enemy intentions. Shields favor fire, heavy strikes favor guard, and cold and overheating complicate heat management across three battles.
en.howToPlay: Read the next enemy action and choose one of four buttons. Cut adds 2 heat, fire spends 3 heat to deal 6 damage, and guard blocks 5 damage. Exceeding 6 heat causes a burn.
en.libraryDecision: A large flat enemy figure and HTML values keep intentions and actions readable. A 3D battlefield or rendering and physics libraries would distract from the four-action decision.
en.soundDecision: No sound, allowing players to read intentions and results at their own pace. Text and state changes communicate effects.

aiReview.worst: 敵の行動列と三連戦が固定で、一度勝ち筋を見つけると育成や新しい選択が増えない。
aiReview.comment: 二番人で大打撃を防いで盾に火術を通し、最後は斬撃で倒して熱5を持ち越せた。三戦目は冷気の前に倒し、体力10・薬2で完了。順番を考える場面はできたが、短い固定戦闘の範囲に留まる。

similar.title: Into the Breach
similar.note: 敵の攻撃予告を見て、被害を防ぐ行動を選ぶ点が近い。本作は盤面移動のない一対一の三連戦で、熱の増減と四行動だけを扱う。
similar.note_en: Both telegraph enemy attacks so the player can counter them. This is three one-on-one fights without grid movement, using heat and four fixed actions.

aiReview.research: 敵の行動予告を扱う作品を2検索し、Subset Games公式のInto the Breach説明を確認。

en.worst: Enemy sequences and the three fights are fixed; finding a winning line adds no growth or new choices.
en.comment: Guarding the second keeper's heavy hit, piercing its shield with fire, then finishing with a cut preserved five heat. The last keeper fell before its cold attack, leaving ten health and two potions. Order matters, but this remains a short fixed combat puzzle.
en.research: Two searches for games with enemy intentions; checked the official Into the Breach description by Subset Games.

aiReview.method: スマホ縦画面で 18 手プレイ（時間を止めて1手ずつ操作）
aiReview.methodEn: Played 18 moves on a portrait phone screen (time frozen between moves)

playLog.note: 二手先に盾が見える。熱をためて次の打撃前に倒す方針。
playLog.noteEn: The shield is visible two actions ahead; building heat for a killing fire.

playLog.note: 斬って熱2。盾の次に4傷の打撃が来る。
playLog.noteEn: Cut for 2 heat; a 4-damage strike follows the shield.

playLog.note: 盾へ斬って熱を4までためた。
playLog.noteEn: Cutting into the shield raises heat to four.

playLog.note: 火術で一戦目を抜けた。倒した像が暗くなり、戦闘終了の表示になった。
playLog.noteEn: Fire wins the first battle; the defeated figure dims and the preview ends.

playLog.note: 二戦目。ためのあとに7傷が来ると最初から見える。
playLog.noteEn: The second battle previews a 7-damage blow after charging.

playLog.note: ための間に斬り、大打撃を防御。次の盾を貫く熱4を残せた。
playLog.noteEn: Cut while charging, guard the heavy blow, and retain four heat for the shield.

playLog.note: 盾を無視して6傷。冷気の前に熱を使い、失う分を減らせた。
playLog.noteEn: Fire pierces the shield and spends heat before the cold can remove it.

playLog.note: 冷気で熱が1に落ちた。ための間にもう一度ため直せる。
playLog.noteEn: Cold reduces heat to one; the charging turn allows rebuilding it.

playLog.note: 熱3と敵の体力2。次の大打撃を受ける前に倒せる。
playLog.noteEn: Heat three versus two enemy health: a kill can prevent the next heavy blow.

playLog.note: ここは火術を使わず斬撃で倒し、熱5を次へ持ち越す。
playLog.noteEn: A cut finishes the keeper while preserving five heat for the final battle.

playLog.note: 三番人へ。熱5ならすぐ火術を使えるが、斬ると火傷になる。
playLog.noteEn: Five carried heat enables immediate fire, while another cut would burn.

playLog.note: 冷気の前に熱を使って6傷。次は防御で冷気の傷を抑えたい。
playLog.noteEn: Spending heat before cold deals six damage; guarding next can block the cold hit.

playLog.note: 冷気の傷は防げたが、熱は1まで減った。
playLog.noteEn: Guard blocks the cold damage, but heat still falls to one.

playLog.note: 盾を叩いて熱3に。次のためる間に火術を使える。
playLog.noteEn: Cutting the shield builds three heat for fire during the charge.

playLog.note: ためる間に6傷を与えた。大打撃8には防御を合わせる。
playLog.noteEn: Fire deals six during the charge; guard is ready for the heavy eight.

playLog.note: 8傷を3傷へ抑えた。敵はあと8、こちらは体力14。
playLog.noteEn: Guard cuts eight damage to three; the enemy has eight health and I have fourteen.

playLog.note: 斬撃で敵を6に、熱を3にできた。冷気が来る前の火術で決着できる。
playLog.noteEn: A cut leaves six enemy health and three heat; fire can finish before the cold.

playLog.note: 三番人を越えた。最後の冷気を受けずに終え、体力10と薬2を残せた。
playLog.noteEn: All three keepers passed; the final cold never lands, leaving ten health and two potions.

metrics.method: Codexのtoken_usage_recordをresponse_idで重複除去し企画開始から自己判定完了まで集計。入力はキャッシュ込み、出力は思考を控除。ツールはトップレベル呼出のみ。
metrics.methodEn: Aggregated unique Codex response usage from planning through review. Input includes cached tokens; output excludes reasoning; tools count top-level calls.
